name.ja: Figure-riseStandard　孫悟空＆クリリン DXセット
name.en: Figure-riseStandard Son Goku & Krillin DX Set

description.ja: Figure-riseStandard 孫悟空とクリリンがDXセットで登場！！
description.en: Figure-riseStandard Son Goku and Krillin are now available as a DX set! !

description.ja: • DXセット限定の気を纏ったバトルオーラカラーで悟空とクリリンのセットが登場！
description.en: • A set of Goku and Krillin is now available in a battle aura color that is exclusive to the DX set!

description.ja: • DXセット限定のFigure-riseEffectのクリア台座が1つ付属。劇中再現がさらに面白く！
description.en: • One clear pedestal of Figure-rise Effect limited to DX set is included. Reenactment from the movie is even more interesting!

必殺技エフェクト2種（かめはめ波溜め、かめはめ波放出）×各１

accessories.ja: 表情パーツ3種（通常、怒り、笑顔）×各1
accessories.en: 3 types of facial expression parts (normal, angry, smiling) x 1 each

accessories.ja: 手首パーツ5種（左右握り手、左右かめはめ波手、右平手）×各1

accessories.ja: 必殺技エフェクト2種（連続気功波、気円斬）×各１
